notes.title: War of the Gods Player Feedback Q&A
notes.notes:
Hello fellow players! It's been almost a month since the official version of War of the Gods went live. In these days, some players put forward very valuable opinions to us, we have one by one to see to understand the insights of each player on the game, and recorded in our version of the development program, the following we will be in the form of Q&A to solve the problem of the players!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638173/73be80754e01f7cf8db3696c46843301fe992431.jpg[/img]
[h3][Q&A session][/h3

Q: “There will be bugs in the game screen, and the pop-up text box for interacting with items will be stuck”
A: “We have fixed this problem, players who encountered the problem can try to play again”
 
Q: “When encountering sandworms it will lag and can't move on. And after restarting the game, the attribute values of all equipment will change to 0.”
A: “We have found a solution and will fix the whole issue in the next version.”
 
Q: “The POV doesn't match the live gameplay”
A: “This was an oversight on our part and we would like to say sorry to all players. We will fix the images on the steam page that don't match the live gameplay in the near future”
 
Q: “Wings are not very useful, rather ribbed”
A: “We will add the wing sprint function, combined with sprint casting artifacts, can have some combat function”
 
Q: “Boss skill effects are hard to see, easy to be killed in seconds”
A: “We have thought of a good solution, will be appropriate to extend the red circle prompt time will not let you players appear to react in a timely manner”
 
Q: “do not want to die to return to the city, and hope to increase the warehouse system”
A: “We have discussed this issue carefully, if we add these systems will change the underlying framework of the game, we still focus on meat pigeon gameplay, so I'm sorry and can not be increased”
 
Thank you for all the players for the love of the war of the gods, each of your insights for us are invaluable wealth, look forward to our next encounter, I believe the war of the gods will give you a satisfactory answer!

notes.title: A list of updates planned for subsequent releases!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players! It's been two weeks since the official version of Battle of Gods has been launched, and we haven't disappeared during this time, we have been reading every player's feedback to us carefully, including the bad comments we have also thought and discussed seriously, and we will soon be able to give a perfect answer to all the players.

Not only that, the release of the official version does not mean the end of us, the follow-up still have a wave of content will be online! Let all of you play cool, brush cool!

At the same time, Battle of Gods will also have a lot of brand new gameplay and content coming online.

We're expecting to release 2 large chapters of DLC for free over the course of 6 months or so to fill out the remaining two worlds. Not only that 2 brand new gameplay modes - Tower Climbing Mode and Tower Defense Survival Mode will also be released!

[h2]War of the Gods will be updated in four major releases as nodes! [/h2]

[h3]I. Meat Pigeon Tower Climbing Mode - (expected to be released in mid to late December) [/h3]
Want direct combat cool? Want to pick up the weapon is dry? The new endless tower climbing mode will soon be online!
The game will advance with a layer of minion maps a layer of boss maps to play, of course the bosses will be changed, adding words to increase the challenge of the fight. We will be using the 10 level map as a mini-objective to serve as an archive point as well as increase the difficulty. Bypass the various subplots and just fight!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638173/6966b161783a692bba753a56c43dc71a4b445623.png[/img]
[h3]Chapter 2: “The Fifth World” DLC Free Update! --Expected to be released in March[/h3].
We're building on the official version of the critically acclaimed Fourth World! Brought to you in the form of a brand new free dlc. The Fourth World will also see the arrival of new and distinctive characters, and guess who you'll recognize? Of course, more new weapons, new companions, and new artifacts are also essential to enriching our bd library, so let your imagination run wild.

[h3]Three, tower defense survival mode - expected to launch in April[/h3]
For rpg friends are blessed! The new Rpg day and night survival mode is being planned, brush the equipment during the day to do the task, get the help of partners, and fend off the powerful enemy at night. See if your perseverance and determination hold fast to the holy relics of the gods.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638173/027afc76bd4e0d84415dc4577b41997f4f7da13b.png[/img]
[h3]IV. Chapter “World 6” DLC Free update! --Launched in June[/h3].
The story of the Infinite Epic comes to an end with the fated showdown between Raiju and Lucifer! A brand new companion and bd trio will serve as your right hand man to write the final chapter of Infinite Epic with you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638173/9f1c85d470dca183e27d0c940c2c4a4a9a102403.png[/img]
[h3]V. Player community building[/h3]
     Without affecting the development of the version, we will also carry out a series of community operation activities. We will do the genre strategy activity in the bar, collect the genre of the players into a strategy to help players who want to just start. At the same time, the Battle of Gods Chronicles and the Battle of Gods Characters will also be updated to make it easier for players who want to browse the story of the previous game.

  Finally, thank you for your support of the “War of the Gods” for a long time, we will not run away, and we will not turn a blind eye to the feedback of the players. We will use practical action to complete the “War of the Gods: Infinite Epic” with all our heart, and will never let you players cold heart, please rest assured that all players and friends boldly believe in our attitude!

notes.title: EA V8824 patch notes（April, 9th, 2024）
notes.notes:
1. The mages bonus has been changed to affect the number of projectiles.
2. The Druid bonus has been changed to elemental damage, removing the reflected damage bonus
3.Fixed the issue with boss attack intervals. Melee classes can now properly respond to boss attacks.

6. Added the Miner Set - Bomber man, increased bomb damage attributes in artifacts, now you can play as a bomber.
7. A limit has been set on the number of companions that can be deployed. You can now manually choose which companions to deploy from the companion menu.
8. Epic and Legendary companions have received significant buffs in combat. Companions can now draw monster aggro and block some ranged monster skills. The racial bonuses for companions remain unchanged, and all companions can contribute passive attributes to the main character.
9. Dismissing companions now returns gold. The higher the level of the stage, the more gold returned.
10. Reduced the damage and cooldown of certain skills for Sand Throat, Skull King, Medusa, Ice Goddess, and Bloody Goddess.
11. Modified the talent 'God of the Giant Eagle.' Now, you must acquire the prefix 'Companion Increases Character Attack Power' from equipment and artifacts.
12. Increased the resistance of equipment and enhanced the initial resistance of all characters. You now have more elemental defense.
13. Fixed the issue where items wouldn't refresh in the item shop after destroying furniture.
14. Fixed the issue where resurrection talent wouldn't trigger correctly.
15. Increased the efficiency of divine skill charging, you can now gain charges from hitting targets.
16. Characters gain additional shield increase and duration extension upon revival.
17. Controllers now have automatic 360-degree aiming.
18. Added resolutions: 2160x1080, 2880x1440.
19. Fixed the issue where controllers couldn't scroll in the companion interface.
20. Increased the pickup range for gold coins and soul crystals.
